Johns Hopkins Medicine provides a diverse and inclusive environment that fosters intellectual discovery, creates and transmits innovative knowledge, improves human health, and provides medical leadership to the world.

feeds.title: Duke Research Blog » Biomedical Engineering
feeds.description: Following the people and events that make up the research community at Duke. This blog is a companion to the Duke Research news site that provides informal updates about Duke University research community. It is a team blog written by three professional science writers from University Communications, and a crew of undergraduate work-study students who watch the campus for interesting events, personalities and projects.

feeds.title: Bigfoot Biomedical Blog
feeds.description: Bigfoot Biomedical was founded by people affected by and living with Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) and is committed to leveraging data, people, and smart technology to create a connected ecosystem of solutions that will deliver improved outcomes valued by patients, providers, and payers.

feeds.title: BMC blog network
feeds.description: We have six blogs, covering all areas of biology, biomedicine, and medicine, as well as open access publishing. A pioneer of open access publishing, BMC has an evolving portfolio of high quality peer-reviewed journals including broad interest titles such as BMC Biology and BMC Medicine, specialist journals such as Malaria Journal and Microbiome, and the BMC series.

feeds.title: Biomedical Beat Blog

This blog is from the National Institute of General Medical Sciences, one of the National Institutes of Health in the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.
